abihail_29.name: Abihail
abihail_29.who: Wife of Abishur in Judah's line of Jerahmeel, and mother of Ahban and Molid.
key: Abishur's wife was named Abihail (1 Chronicles 2).
She bore him Ahban and Molid (1 Chronicles 2).

abishur_53.name: Abishur
abishur_53.who: A man of Judah in Jerahmeel's line, son of Shammai, husband of Abihail, and father of Ahban and Molid.
key: Shammai's sons were Nadab and Abishur (1 Chronicles 2).
Abishur's wife Abihail bore him Ahban and Molid (1 Chronicles 2).

ahban_122.name: Ahban
ahban_122.who: A man of Judah in Jerahmeel's line, son of Abishur and his wife Abihail.
key: Abishur's wife Abihail bore him Ahban and Molid (1 Chronicles 2).
He is listed among the descendants of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2).

molid_2105.name: Molid
molid_2105.who: A man of Judah in Jerahmeel's line, son of Abishur and his wife Abihail.
key: Abishur's wife Abihail bore him Ahban and Molid (1 Chronicles 2).
He is listed among the descendants of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2).

nadab_2130.name: Nadab
nadab_2130.who: A man of Judah in Jerahmeel's line, son of Shammai and father of Seled and Appaim.
key: The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur (1 Chronicles 2).
The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; Seled died childless (1 Chronicles 2).

peleth_2312.name: Peleth
peleth_2312.who: A man of Judah, son of Jonathan, in the line of Jerahmeel.
key: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza (1 Chronicles 2).
These were the descendants of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).

zaza_2987.name: Zaza
zaza_2987.who: A man of Judah, son of Jonathan, in the line of Jerahmeel.
key: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza (1 Chronicles 2).
These were the descendants of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).

regem_2407.name: Regem
regem_2407.who: A man of Judah, son of Jahdai, listed among the descendants of Caleb.
key: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph (1 Chronicles 2).
Jahdai's family is listed among the descendants of Caleb, brother of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).

pelet_2309.name: Pelet
pelet_2309.who: A man of Judah, son of Jahdai, listed among the descendants of Caleb.
key: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph (1 Chronicles 2).
Jahdai's family is listed among the descendants of Caleb, brother of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).

shaaph_2506.name: Shaaph
shaaph_2506.who: A man of Judah, son of Jahdai, listed among the descendants of Caleb.
key: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph (1 Chronicles 2).
Jahdai's family is listed among the descendants of Caleb, brother of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).

maachah_1842.name: Maacah
maachah_1842.who: A concubine of Caleb son of Hezron, and mother of sons who fathered towns in Judah.
key: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah (1 Chronicles 2).
She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea (1 Chronicles 2).

ephratah_1207.name: Ephrathah
ephratah_1207.who: A wife of Caleb son of Hezron and mother of Hur, from whose line came the founder of Bethlehem.
key: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur (1 Chronicles 2).
The sons of Hur, her firstborn, included Salma the father of Bethlehem (1 Chronicles 2).
Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, is called the father of Bethlehem (1 Chronicles 4).

jered_846.name: Jered
jered_846.who: A man of Judah named in Chronicles as the father, likely the founder, of the town of Gedor.
key: A Judahite wife bore Jered father of Gedor, Heber father of Soco, and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah (1 Chronicles 4).
He and his brothers are listed among the clans of Judah (1 Chronicles 4).

heber_1471.name: Heber
heber_1471.who: A man of Judah named in Chronicles as the father, likely the founder, of the town of Soco.
key: A Judahite wife bore Jered father of Gedor, Heber father of Soco, and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah (1 Chronicles 4).
He and his brothers are listed among the clans of Judah (1 Chronicles 4).

hodaiah_1539.name: Hodaviah
hodaiah_1539.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the seven sons of Elioenai.
key: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven (1 Chronicles 3).
His family belonged to the royal line of Zerubbabel and King Jehoiachin (1 Chronicles 3).

eliashib_1093.name: Eliashib
eliashib_1093.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the seven sons of Elioenai.
key: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven (1 Chronicles 3).
His family belonged to the royal line of Zerubbabel and King Jehoiachin (1 Chronicles 3).

johanan_1668.name: Johanan
johanan_1668.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the seven sons of Elioenai.
key: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven (1 Chronicles 3).
His family belonged to the royal line of Zerubbabel and King Jehoiachin (1 Chronicles 3).

anani_256.name: Anani
anani_256.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the seven sons of Elioenai.
key: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven (1 Chronicles 3).
His family belonged to the royal line of Zerubbabel and King Jehoiachin (1 Chronicles 3).

hattush_1457.name: Hattush
hattush_1457.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the sons of Shemaiah.
key: The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six (1 Chronicles 3).
Shemaiah was the son of Shecaniah, in the royal line of Zerubbabel (1 Chronicles 3).

igeal_595.name: Igal
igeal_595.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the sons of Shemaiah.
key: The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six (1 Chronicles 3).
Shemaiah was the son of Shecaniah, in the royal line of Zerubbabel (1 Chronicles 3).

bariah_402.name: Bariah
bariah_402.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the sons of Shemaiah.
key: The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six (1 Chronicles 3).
Shemaiah was the son of Shecaniah, in the royal line of Zerubbabel (1 Chronicles 3).

shaphat_2554.name: Shaphat
shaphat_2554.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, one of the sons of Shemaiah.
key: The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six (1 Chronicles 3).
Shemaiah was the son of Shecaniah, in the royal line of Zerubbabel (1 Chronicles 3).

shemaiah_2620.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2620.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, son of Shecaniah and father of Neariah and his brothers.
key: The son of Shecaniah was Shemaiah (1 Chronicles 3).
The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six (1 Chronicles 3).

shemaiah_2622.name: Shemaiah
shemaiah_2622.who: A Reubenite in the line of Joel, son of Joel and father of Gog.
key: The sons of Joel are traced through Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, and Baal (1 Chronicles 5).
The line continued to Beerah, a Reubenite chief whom Tiglath-pileser of Assyria carried into exile (1 Chronicles 5).

gog_1325.name: Gog
gog_1325.who: A Reubenite in the line of Joel, son of Shemaiah and father of Shimei.
key: The sons of Joel are traced through Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, and Baal (1 Chronicles 5).
The line continued to Beerah, a Reubenite chief whom Tiglath-pileser of Assyria carried into exile (1 Chronicles 5).

shimei_2688.name: Shimei
shimei_2688.who: A Reubenite in the line of Joel, son of Gog and father of Micah.
key: The sons of Joel are traced through Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, and Baal (1 Chronicles 5).
The line continued to Beerah, a Reubenite chief whom Tiglath-pileser of Assyria carried into exile (1 Chronicles 5).

micah_2050.name: Micah
micah_2050.who: A Reubenite in the line of Joel, son of Shimei and father of Reaiah.
key: The sons of Joel are traced through Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, and Baal (1 Chronicles 5).
The line continued to Beerah, a Reubenite chief whom Tiglath-pileser of Assyria carried into exile (1 Chronicles 5).

reaia_2398.name: Reaiah
reaia_2398.who: A Reubenite in the line of Joel, son of Micah and father of Baal.
key: The sons of Joel are traced through Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, and Baal (1 Chronicles 5).
The line continued to Beerah, a Reubenite chief whom Tiglath-pileser of Assyria carried into exile (1 Chronicles 5).

meshullam_2022.name: Meshullam
meshullam_2022.who: A Gadite, one of the seven sons of Abihail who headed fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail's sons Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber headed their fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).
They were recorded in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

sheba_2571.name: Sheba
sheba_2571.who: A Gadite, one of the seven sons of Abihail who headed fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail's sons Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber headed their fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).
They were recorded in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

jorai_1704.name: Jorai
jorai_1704.who: A Gadite, one of the seven sons of Abihail who headed fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail's sons Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber headed their fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).
They were recorded in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

zia_3059.name: Zia
zia_3059.who: A Gadite, one of the seven sons of Abihail who headed fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail's sons Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber headed their fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).
They were recorded in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

heber_1472.name: Eber
heber_1472.who: A Gadite, one of the seven sons of Abihail who headed fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail's sons Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber headed their fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).
They were recorded in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

huri_1576.name: Huri
huri_1576.who: A Gadite, son of Jaroah and father of Abihail, whose sons headed families in Gilead and Bashan.
key: Abihail son of Huri, son of Jaroah, is traced back to Buz in Gad's genealogy (1 Chronicles 5).
Huri's grandsons headed Gadite fathers' houses in Gilead and Bashan (1 Chronicles 5).

jeshishai_890.name: Jeshishai
jeshishai_890.who: A Gadite, son of Jahdo and father of Michael, in the ancestry of Abihail's family.
key: Abihail's line runs through Michael son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan, and in the pasturelands of Sharon (1 Chronicles 5).

tahath_2814.name: Tahath
tahath_2814.who: A Kohathite Levite, son of Assir and father of Uriel, in the ancestry of the singer Heman.
key: Chronicles lists Assir, Tahath, and Uriel in succession among Kohath's descendants (1 Chronicles 6).
Heman's ancestry names Zephaniah son of Tahath, son of Assir (1 Chronicles 6).

shaul_2563.name: Shaul
shaul_2563.who: A Kohathite Levite, son of Uzziah, named in Chronicles' genealogy of Kohath's descendants.
key: Chronicles lists Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul in succession among Kohath's descendants (1 Chronicles 6).
Kohath's line produced Heman, a singer David put in charge of the service of song (1 Chronicles 6).

bani_389.name: Bani
bani_389.who: A Levite of Merari's clan, son of Shemer, in the ancestry of Ethan, a singer appointed by David.
key: Ethan's ancestry runs through Amzi son of Bani, son of Shemer (1 Chronicles 6).
Ethan and his Merarite brothers stood at Heman's left hand in the service of song (1 Chronicles 6).

abishua_51.name: Abishua
abishua_51.who: A priest descended from Aaron, son of Phinehas and father of Bukki, in the high-priestly line.
key: Phinehas son of Eleazar fathered Abishua, and Abishua fathered Bukki (1 Chronicles 6).
He is named again among Aaron's descendants through Eleazar (1 Chronicles 6).
Ezra's ancestry is traced back through Abishua to Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron (Ezra 7).

abiah_15.name: Abijah
abiah_15.who: Samuel's second son, who judged in Beersheba with his brother Joel but took bribes and perverted justice.
key: Samuel made his sons Joel and Abijah judges in Beersheba (1 Samuel 8).
They turned aside after gain, took bribes, and perverted justice (1 Samuel 8).
Their conduct led Israel's elders to ask Samuel for a king (1 Samuel 8).
Chronicles names Joel as Samuel's firstborn and Abijah as the second (1 Chronicles 6).

jediael_757.name: Jediael
jediael_757.who: A son of Benjamin whose descendants through Bilhan were mighty warriors and heads of fathers' houses.
key: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three (1 Chronicles 7).
Jediael's son was Bilhan, whose seven sons are named (1 Chronicles 7).
His descendants, heads of fathers' houses, numbered 17,200 mighty warriors ready for war (1 Chronicles 7).

jeush_1601.name: Jeush
jeush_1601.who: A Benjaminite, son of Bilhan, whose family was counted among Benjamin's mighty warriors.
key: The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar (1 Chronicles 7).
They were heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200 able to go to war (1 Chronicles 7).

ehud_1040.name: Ehud
ehud_1040.who: A Benjaminite, son of Bilhan, whose family was counted among Benjamin's mighty warriors.
key: The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar (1 Chronicles 7).
They were heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200 able to go to war (1 Chronicles 7).

chenaanah_933.name: Chenaanah
chenaanah_933.who: A Benjaminite, son of Bilhan, whose family was counted among Benjamin's mighty warriors.
key: The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar (1 Chronicles 7).
They were heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200 able to go to war (1 Chronicles 7).

zethan_3057.name: Zethan
zethan_3057.who: A Benjaminite, son of Bilhan, whose family was counted among Benjamin's mighty warriors.
key: The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar (1 Chronicles 7).
They were heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200 able to go to war (1 Chronicles 7).

ahishahar_160.name: Ahishahar
ahishahar_160.who: A Benjaminite, son of Bilhan, whose family was counted among Benjamin's mighty warriors.
key: The sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar (1 Chronicles 7).
They were heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200 able to go to war (1 Chronicles 7).

michael_2063.name: Michael
michael_2063.who: A Benjaminite, son of Beriah, named among the family heads of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.
key: Michael, Ispah, and Joha are named among the sons of Beriah (1 Chronicles 8).
Beriah and Shema, heads in Aijalon, had put the inhabitants of Gath to flight (1 Chronicles 8).
These heads of fathers' houses, chief men, lived in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 8).

ispah_644.name: Ispah
ispah_644.who: A Benjaminite, son of Beriah, named among the family heads of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.
key: Michael, Ispah, and Joha are named among the sons of Beriah (1 Chronicles 8).
Beriah and Shema, heads in Aijalon, had put the inhabitants of Gath to flight (1 Chronicles 8).
These heads of fathers' houses, chief men, lived in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 8).

joha_1664.name: Joha
joha_1664.who: A Benjaminite, son of Beriah, named among the family heads of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.
key: Michael, Ispah, and Joha are named among the sons of Beriah (1 Chronicles 8).
Beriah and Shema, heads in Aijalon, had put the inhabitants of Gath to flight (1 Chronicles 8).
These heads of fathers' houses, chief men, lived in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 8).

shema_2616.name: Shema
shema_2616.who: A Benjaminite family head in Aijalon who, with Beriah, put the inhabitants of Gath to flight.
key: Beriah and Shema were heads of fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon (1 Chronicles 8).
They caused the inhabitants of Gath to flee (1 Chronicles 8).

alemeth_185.name: Alemeth
alemeth_185.who: A Benjaminite descendant of King Saul through Jonathan, son of Jarah, also called Jehoaddah.
key: Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, in the line of Saul through Jonathan (1 Chronicles 8).
The genealogy repeated before Saul's death calls their father Jarah (1 Chronicles 9).

azmaveth_556.name: Azmaveth
azmaveth_556.who: A Benjaminite descendant of King Saul through Jonathan, son of Jarah, also called Jehoaddah.
key: Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, in the line of Saul through Jonathan (1 Chronicles 8).
The genealogy repeated before Saul's death calls their father Jarah (1 Chronicles 9).

zimri_3089.name: Zimri
zimri_3089.who: A Benjaminite descendant of King Saul through Jonathan, son of Jarah, also called Jehoaddah.
key: Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, in the line of Saul through Jonathan (1 Chronicles 8).
Zimri fathered Moza, continuing the line of Saul's descendants (1 Chronicles 8).
The genealogy repeated before Saul's death calls their father Jarah (1 Chronicles 9).

shephathiah_2656.name: Shephatiah
shephathiah_2656.who: A Benjaminite, son of Reuel, whose son Meshullam headed a father's house in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah, is listed among Jerusalem's Benjaminites (1 Chronicles 9).
All these men were heads of fathers' houses (1 Chronicles 9).

rehabiah_2409.name: Rehabiah
rehabiah_2409.who: A Levite, the only son of Moses' son Eliezer, whose descendants became very numerous.
key: Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many (1 Chronicles 23).
Isshiah was the chief among the sons of Rehabiah (1 Chronicles 24).
His descendants included Shelomoth, who oversaw the treasuries of dedicated gifts (1 Chronicles 26).

shelomith_2609.name: Shelomoth
shelomith_2609.who: A Levite descended from Moses' son Eliezer, who oversaw the treasuries of gifts dedicated to the LORD.
key: Eliezer's line ran through Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, and Zichri to Shelomoth (1 Chronicles 26).
Shelomoth and his brothers oversaw the gifts dedicated by David and his army commanders (1 Chronicles 26).
Gifts dedicated by Samuel, Saul, Abner, and Joab were also in their care (1 Chronicles 26).

shelomoth_2608.name: Shelomith
shelomoth_2608.who: A Levite, chief of the sons of Izhar, listed when David organized the Levites.
key: The sons of Izhar were led by Shelomith the chief (1 Chronicles 23).
Among the Izharites, Shelomoth is listed with his son Jahath (1 Chronicles 24).

jesaiah_884.name: Jeshaiah
jesaiah_884.who: A Benjaminite, father of Ithiel and earliest named ancestor of Sallu, who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is traced through Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, and Ithiel to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).
These Benjaminites were among the people who lived in Jerusalem, the holy city (Nehemiah 11).

ithiel_650.name: Ithiel
ithiel_650.who: A Benjaminite, son of Jeshaiah and father of Maaseiah, in the ancestry of Sallu of Jerusalem.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is traced through Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, and Ithiel to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).
These Benjaminites were among the people who lived in Jerusalem, the holy city (Nehemiah 11).

maaseiah_1863.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1863.who: A Benjaminite, son of Ithiel and father of Kolaiah, in the ancestry of Sallu of Jerusalem.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is traced through Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, and Ithiel to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).
These Benjaminites were among the people who lived in Jerusalem, the holy city (Nehemiah 11).

kolaiah_1791.name: Kolaiah
kolaiah_1791.who: A Benjaminite, son of Maaseiah and father of Pedaiah, in the ancestry of Sallu of Jerusalem.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is traced through Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, and Ithiel to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).
These Benjaminites were among the people who lived in Jerusalem, the holy city (Nehemiah 11).

pedaiah_2297.name: Pedaiah
pedaiah_2297.who: A Benjaminite, son of Kolaiah and father of Joed, in the ancestry of Sallu of Jerusalem.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is traced through Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, and Ithiel to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).
These Benjaminites were among the people who lived in Jerusalem, the holy city (Nehemiah 11).

joel_1659.name: Joel
joel_1659.who: A Benjaminite, son of Zichri, overseer of the Benjaminites who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Gabbai and Sallai and 928 Benjaminites lived in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).
Joel son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second over the city (Nehemiah 11).

pelaliah_2303.name: Pelaliah
pelaliah_2303.who: A priest in the ancestry of Adaiah, who served in the house of the LORD after the exile.
key: Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, is listed among the priests in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).
His line is traced back through Zechariah and Pashhur to Malchijah (Nehemiah 11).

hashabiah_1434.name: Hashabiah
hashabiah_1434.who: A Levite of Merari's line who came to Ezra from Casiphia and helped carry the temple offerings to Jerusalem.
key: From Iddo's community at Casiphia came Hashabiah, with Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari (Ezra 8).
Ezra set apart Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten kinsmen to carry the silver, gold, and vessels (Ezra 8).
A Levite named Hashabiah sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day (Nehemiah 10).
Hashabiah and Sherebiah are named among the chiefs of the Levites who led praise and thanksgiving (Nehemiah 12).

jeshaiah_887.name: Jeshaiah
jeshaiah_887.who: A Levite of the sons of Merari who came with Hashabiah from Casiphia to join Ezra's return.
key: Ezra sent to Iddo at Casiphia for ministers for the house of God (Ezra 8).
Hashabiah came, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, with twenty of their kinsmen (Ezra 8).

zerahiah_3048.name: Zerahiah
zerahiah_3048.who: Father of Eliehoenai, who led two hundred men of the family of Pahath-moab back with Ezra.
key: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah came with two hundred men (Ezra 8).
They returned from Babylonia with Ezra in the reign of King Artaxerxes (Ezra 8).

shechaniah_2586.name: Shecaniah
shechaniah_2586.who: A man of the family of Elam, son of Jehiel, who urged Ezra to lead the people in a covenant of repentance.
key: Shecaniah son of Jehiel confessed that the people had broken faith by marrying foreign women (Ezra 10).
He said there was still hope for Israel and proposed a covenant with God (Ezra 10).
He urged Ezra to arise and act, promising that the people were with him (Ezra 10).

hashub_1442.name: Hasshub
hashub_1442.who: A descendant of Pahath-moab who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall and the Tower of the Ovens.
key: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens (Nehemiah 3).
He was one of many who rebuilt the wall section by section in Nehemiah's day (Nehemiah 3).

hashub_1443.name: Hasshub
hashub_1443.who: A man of Jerusalem who, with Benjamin, repaired the wall opposite his house in Nehemiah's day.
key: Benjamin and Hasshub repaired the wall opposite their house (Nehemiah 3).
After them Azariah son of Maaseiah repaired beside his own house (Nehemiah 3).

mehetabeel_1979.name: Mehetabel
mehetabeel_1979.who: Named in Nehemiah as the parent of Delaiah, whose son Shemaiah was hired to frighten Nehemiah.
key: Nehemiah went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel (Nehemiah 6).
Nehemiah perceived that Tobiah and Sanballat had hired Shemaiah against him (Nehemiah 6).

johanan_1698.name: Johanan
johanan_1698.who: A high priest after the exile, named in the high-priestly succession between Joiada and Jaddua.
key: Levite family heads were recorded in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua (Nehemiah 12).
The Levites' heads were written in the Book of the Chronicles until the days of Johanan son of Eliashib (Nehemiah 12).

jaddua_687.name: Jaddua
jaddua_687.who: A high priest after the exile, the last in the line of high priests listed in Nehemiah.
key: The high-priestly line runs from Jeshua through Joiakim, Eliashib, Joiada, and Jonathan to Jaddua (Nehemiah 12).
Levite family heads were recorded in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua (Nehemiah 12).

zechariah_3026.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3026.who: A descendant of Asaph, son of Jonathan, who blew a trumpet at the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt wall.
key: Zechariah son of Jonathan, descended from Asaph, was among the priests' sons with trumpets (Nehemiah 12).
His kinsmen, including Shemaiah, Judah, and Hanani, played the musical instruments of David (Nehemiah 12).
Ezra the scribe went before them as the procession moved along the wall (Nehemiah 12).

jerimoth_869.name: Jerimoth
jerimoth_869.who: A son of David whose daughter Mahalath became a wife of King Rehoboam.
key: Rehoboam took as wife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth son of David (2 Chronicles 11).
Mahalath bore Rehoboam three sons, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham (2 Chronicles 11).

jeush_1603.name: Jeush
jeush_1603.who: A son of King Rehoboam by Mahalath, a granddaughter of David.
key: Mahalath bore Rehoboam sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham (2 Chronicles 11).
Rehoboam later made Maacah's son Abijah chief prince among his brothers (2 Chronicles 11).

shamariah_2531.name: Shemariah
shamariah_2531.who: A son of King Rehoboam by Mahalath, a granddaughter of David.
key: Mahalath bore Rehoboam sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham (2 Chronicles 11).
Rehoboam later made Maacah's son Abijah chief prince among his brothers (2 Chronicles 11).

zaham_2980.name: Zaham
zaham_2980.who: A son of King Rehoboam by Mahalath, a granddaughter of David.
key: Mahalath bore Rehoboam sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham (2 Chronicles 11).
Rehoboam later made Maacah's son Abijah chief prince among his brothers (2 Chronicles 11).

elika_1133.name: Elika
elika_1133.who: A man of Harod, listed among David's thirty mighty men.
key: Shammah of Harod and Elika of Harod are listed among the thirty (2 Samuel 23).
The thirty also included Asahel the brother of Joab and Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem (2 Samuel 23).

phaltiel_2326.name: Palti
phaltiel_2326.who: Son of Laish of Gallim, to whom Saul gave David's wife Michal, and who wept when she was taken back.
key: Saul gave his daughter Michal, David's wife, to Palti son of Laish, of Gallim (1 Samuel 25).
Ish-bosheth took Michal from her husband Paltiel son of Laish at David's demand (2 Samuel 3).
Her husband followed her, weeping, as far as Bahurim, until Abner told him to return (2 Samuel 3).

eliadah_1080.name: Eliada
eliadah_1080.who: Father of Rezon, the Syrian leader who seized Damascus and became an adversary of Solomon.
key: God raised up Rezon son of Eliada as an adversary to Solomon (1 Kings 11).
Rezon had fled from his master Hadadezer king of Zobah and gathered a band of men (1 Kings 11).

chalcol_924.name: Calcol
chalcol_924.who: A famous wise man, a son of Mahol, whose wisdom Solomon surpassed.
key: Solomon was wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol (1 Kings 4).
Solomon's fame spread to all the surrounding nations (1 Kings 4).

darda_977.name: Darda
darda_977.who: A famous wise man, a son of Mahol, whose wisdom Solomon surpassed.
key: Solomon was wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol (1 Kings 4).
Solomon's fame spread to all the surrounding nations (1 Kings 4).

mahol_1898.name: Mahol
mahol_1898.who: Father of the wise men Heman, Calcol, and Darda, whose wisdom Solomon surpassed.
key: Solomon was wiser than Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol (1 Kings 4).
Solomon's wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the people of the east and of Egypt (1 Kings 4).

melchiah_1989.name: Malchiah
melchiah_1989.who: Father of Pashhur, an official of King Zedekiah who sought Jeremiah's death.
key: King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malchiah to Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD (Jeremiah 21).
Pashhur son of Malchiah was among the officials who heard Jeremiah and urged that he be put to death (Jeremiah 38).

tikvah_2855.name: Tikvah
tikvah_2855.who: Father of Shallum, keeper of the wardrobe and husband of the prophetess Huldah in Josiah's day.
key: Josiah's officials went to Huldah, wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas (2 Kings 22).
Chronicles calls him Tokhath son of Hasrah (2 Chronicles 34).

amariah_206.name: Amariah
amariah_206.who: An ancestor of the prophet Zephaniah, son of Hezekiah and father of Gedaliah.
key: Zephaniah was son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah (Zephaniah 1).
The word of the LORD came to his descendant Zephaniah in the days of Josiah king of Judah (Zephaniah 1).

dodo_1020.name: Dodo
dodo_1020.who: A man of Issachar, father of Puah and grandfather of Tola, who judged Israel after Abimelech.
key: Tola son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel (Judges 10).
Tola judged Israel twenty-three years and was buried at Shamir (Judges 10).

mehujael_1983.name: Mehujael
mehujael_1983.who: A descendant of Cain, son of Irad and father of Methushael, in the line leading to Lamech.
key: Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael (Genesis 4).
Methushael fathered Lamech, who took two wives, Adah and Zillah (Genesis 4).

naamah_2118.name: Naamah
naamah_2118.who: Daughter of Lamech and Zillah in Cain's line, and sister of Tubal-cain.
key: Lamech took two wives, Adah and Zillah (Genesis 4).
Zillah bore Tubal-cain, and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah (Genesis 4).

maachah_1840.name: Maacah
maachah_1840.who: A child of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah.
key: Abraham was told that Nahor's concubine Reumah bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah (Genesis 22).
This news of Nahor's family came after God provided a ram in place of Isaac (Genesis 22).

dedan_999.name: Dedan
dedan_999.who: A grandson of Abraham and Keturah, son of Jokshan, whose descendants included the Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
key: Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan (Genesis 25).
The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim (Genesis 25).
Chronicles repeats Dedan among the descendants of Keturah (1 Chronicles 1).

sheba_2569.name: Sheba
sheba_2569.who: A grandson of Abraham and Keturah, son of Jokshan and brother of Dedan.
key: Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan (Genesis 25).
Abraham gave gifts to his sons by his concubines and sent them east, away from Isaac (Genesis 25).
Chronicles repeats Sheba among the descendants of Keturah (1 Chronicles 1).

asshurim_350.name: Asshurim
asshurim_350.who: An Arabian people descended from Dedan, a grandson of Abraham and Keturah.
key: The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim (Genesis 25).
Abraham gave gifts to his sons by his concubines and sent them east, away from Isaac (Genesis 25).
asshurim_350.label: People group

letushim_1818.name: Letushim
letushim_1818.who: An Arabian people descended from Dedan, a grandson of Abraham and Keturah.
key: The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim (Genesis 25).
Abraham gave gifts to his sons by his concubines and sent them east, away from Isaac (Genesis 25).
letushim_1818.label: People group

henoch_1402.name: Hanoch
henoch_1402.who: A son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by Keturah.
key: Midian's sons were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah, all descendants of Keturah (Genesis 25).
Chronicles repeats Midian's sons, including Hanoch (1 Chronicles 1).

ajah_178.name: Aiah
ajah_178.who: A Horite, son of Zibeon and brother of Anah, among the clans of Seir in Edom.
key: The sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah, the Anah who found the hot springs (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats the sons of Zibeon as Aiah and Anah (1 Chronicles 1).

hemdan_1492.name: Hemdan
hemdan_1492.who: A Horite, son of Dishon, among the clans of Seir who lived in the land before Esau's descendants.
key: The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats these sons of Dishon among the descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

eshban_1217.name: Eshban
eshban_1217.who: A Horite, son of Dishon, among the clans of Seir who lived in the land before Esau's descendants.
key: The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats these sons of Dishon among the descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

ithran_653.name: Ithran
ithran_653.who: A Horite, son of Dishon, among the clans of Seir who lived in the land before Esau's descendants.
key: The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats these sons of Dishon among the descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

cheran_937.name: Cheran
cheran_937.who: A Horite, son of Dishon, among the clans of Seir who lived in the land before Esau's descendants.
key: The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats these sons of Dishon among the descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

beor_465.name: Beor
beor_465.who: Father of Bela, the first king listed as reigning in Edom before Israel had kings.
key: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah (Genesis 36).
Chronicles begins its list of Edom's kings with Bela son of Beor (1 Chronicles 1).

bedad_426.name: Bedad
bedad_426.who: Father of Hadad, a king of Edom who defeated Midian in the country of Moab.
key: After Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad reigned in Edom (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats Hadad son of Bedad among Edom's kings (1 Chronicles 1).

hadad_1338.name: Hadad
hadad_1338.who: A king of Edom, son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab and reigned from Avith.
key: After Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad reigned in Edom (Genesis 36).
He defeated Midian in the country of Moab, and the name of his city was Avith (Genesis 36).
When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats this list of Edom's kings (1 Chronicles 1).

secundus_2482.name: Secundus
secundus_2482.who: A believer from Thessalonica who accompanied Paul as he left Greece for Jerusalem.
key: Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians were among Paul's travel companions (Acts 20).
These companions went on ahead and waited for Paul at Troas (Acts 20).
